experiment: V0.6.0 repository graph offline retrieval re-evaluation
comparison: same task descriptions, base commits, gold-patch file labels, 12 candidate limit, and filename-keyword baseline as the previous V0.6.0 run
interpretation: Graph expansion improves top-5 coverage and recall on this three-task screen, but it does not improve top-1 ranking and only ties baseline MRR. This is evidence for further ranking work, not a claim of production-quality localization.
